terms.meaning: When the system saw the text.

sections.name: RetrievalDoc
sections.title: A searchable document record
sections.what: Describes a document with its id, source id, the time it was observed and its text.
sections.watch_out: The time is stored as text, so comparing it with the cutoff depends on a consistent format.

summary: Defines one searchable document: its text plus where it came from and when it was observed.
purpose: The standard shape for documents that retrieval searches.
why: The comment says this records the source and observation time with the text.
how: Defines an id, a source id, an observed time and the text.
risks: The observed time is text, not a date object, so a malformed value is not caught here.
debug: If search ignores documents, check the format of their observed time.
